objective.name: expected_item
objective.description: Defines one event, intention result, or continuity return expected by a wait group.

functional._type_note: Required. Identifies the kind of expected event.
functional._ref_note: Required. Canonical reference identifying the expected continuity or external event. An intention of the same output is not listed: the pilot cannot know its identifier, and the wait group waits for all of the awaited intentions of its output by default. A pilot that you launch with pilot.launch and a task is NOT listed either: the answer of the launch is its result, so the awaited launch intention is what the group waits for (leave expected empty). The type continuity is only for a continuity launched earlier that reports back by message.
functional._correlation_note: Required correlation data used to match an incoming message or result with this expected item.
